title: Expression, purification, and characterization of CtVPS13(1-635) with calmodulin
author: Dazhi Li
materials: buffer A (500 mM NaCl, 50 mM HEPES, pH 7.8)

steps.title: Transform plasmids into BL21 cells
steps.instruction: Transform pETDuet-6xHis-Strep-CtVPS13(1–635) or pETDuet-6xHis-Strep-CtVPS13(1–635)-6xHis-HsCaM into homemade BL21(DE3) pLys cells; note that the latter construct places VPS13 in the first ORF and calmodulin in the second ORF.

steps.title: Grow and induce expression culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate a 1 L LB culture, grow at 37 °C to OD600 = 0.8, add 0.5 mM IPTG, then shift to 18 °C and continue expression for 16 h.

steps.title: Harvest cells and resuspend
steps.instruction: Harvest cells by centrifugation, resuspend the pellet in 20 mL buffer A (500 mM NaCl, 50 mM HEPES pH 7.8, 10 % glycerol, 1 mM TCEP) containing 1× protease‑inhibitor cocktail and 5 mM imidazole.

steps.title: Lyse cells by high‑pressure homogenization
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension five times through an Avestin EmulsiFlex‑C5 at 7,500 psi.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 36,945 × g for 30 min at 4 °C in a JA‑20 rotor.

steps.title: Bind protein to Talon resin
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Talon metal‑affinity resin to the clarified supernatant, rotate at 4 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Wash Talon resin
steps.instruction: Wash the resin with 50 column volumes of buffer A containing 20 mM imidazole.

steps.title: Elute protein from Talon resin
steps.instruction: Elute with buffer A containing 300 mM imidazole, collecting 1 mL fractions; incubate the resin for 5 min per elution.

steps.title: Optional tandem Strep purification
steps.instruction: Incubate the Talon eluate with 50 µL Strep‑Tactin XT 4Flow high‑capacity resin for 2 h at 4 °C, wash the resin three times with 15 mL buffer A, then elute bound protein three times with 50 µL buffer A supplemented with 50 mM D‑biotin, incubating 20 min per elution.

steps.title: Analyze eluates by SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Run SDS‑PAGE of the Talon (and optional Strep) eluates; note that the CtVPS13 fragment is soluble and purifiable only in the presence of calmodulin.

steps.title: Size‑exclusion chromatography
steps.instruction: Load the purified protein onto a Superose 6 Increase column equilibrated with buffer A and perform SEC.

steps.title: Analyze SEC fractions by SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Run SDS‑PAGE on SEC fractions; the CtVPS13 fragment forms a 1:1 complex with calmodulin and elutes as a peak consistent with a dimeric complex.

steps.title: Negative‑stain EM analysis
steps.instruction: Prepare grids of the purified protein for negative‑stain electron microscopy; 2D classification in CryoSPARC shows homogeneous tube‑like dimeric assemblies matching the AlphaFold model.
